messages:
lee: FYI — Acme Finance says the PO is missing on their invoice INV-2026-334. They can't pay without PO. Screenshot attached. Can we add PO without breaking accounting?

nina: can you paste the invoice id + internal charge id so we can trace?

lee: INV-2026-334, charge ch_abc123def, created 2026-02-28. customer provided PO 44321-ACME and insists the PO must appear on the legal invoice.

zach: quick note: we generally don't edit issued invoices. Typical path is credit + rebill with PO on the new invoice. Need finance sign-off for refunds. cc @emily for approval. :eyes:

emily: got it. I'll own this. Two options: manual refund + new invoice immediately, or formal credit memo + rebill. Which does the customer prefer?

lee: they prefer reissue (want single corrected invoice). Says internal AP won't process a separate credit memo.

emily: understood. That still maps to credit+rebill on our side. I'll request exception and route to finance.

billing-bot: /billing reissue INV-2026-334 --note "Add PO 44321-ACME"

lee: ran the above, bot returned error: 
```
Error 422 ValidationError: invoice status=paid cannot be edited (invoice_id=INV-2026-334)
```

nina: that's expected — reissue automation blocks on paid invoices to avoid altering accounting entries. Need finance to create credit memo first, then generate new invoice with PO.

emily: I'll open a finance approval ticket now. Please confirm total and currency.

lee: total $12,450.00 USD, tax lines included. Customer billing address is US-based (no VAT).

emily: thanks. Filing ticket and requesting expedited approval since AP hold is blocking payment. Attaching customer's PO and screenshot. ETA ~2 business days; if finance approves manual refund we can rebill today.

zach: adding a small runbook note: when /billing reissue fails with "invoice status=paid", escalate to finance and follow credit+rebill flow. I'll add a short snippet to docs.

lee: customer prefers waiting for corrected invoice, not a card refund. They asked for invoice number to point to in their PO system.

emily: finance approved exception for reissue workflow. I'll perform credit memo and create new invoice with PO attached. I'll post the new invoice number when done.

billing-bot: automated: reissue_workflow_start invoice=INV-2026-334 actor=emily method=credit_rebill

emily: performed credit memo and generated new invoice INV-2026-334-R1 with PO=44321-ACME. Marked original INV-2026-334 as refunded. Sent PDF to customer.

lee: confirmed receipt from customer, AP accepted the new invoice and scheduled payment. Thanks everyone.

nina: leaving a note: update support playbook to include exact commands and the validation error text so folks know this is expected.

emily: noted — I'll also add link to finance ticket for audit. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
